purpose: What is left after every full tray is packed?
meaning: Modular arithmetic groups integers by their remainders for a fixed positive modulus. Divide the nonnegative total by the positive tray capacity. The integer quotient counts full trays and the remainder counts leftovers.

definition.setting: Pack n counters into full trays holding m counters each. The leftover count is the nonnegative remainder.

signature.m: Positive number of counters in a full tray.
signature.r: Nonnegative leftover count, strictly smaller than one tray.

conditions: This executable family uses nonnegative whole counts and positive tray sizes. Congruence compares remainder classes; the tray picture is not a proof about every integer.
All chosen inputs are whole numbers in the declared finite ranges. Both views and the story use the same evaluated state.

properties.derivation: If n=qm+r, then n+m=(q+1)m+r. The remainder remains in the same allowed interval when both displayed totals fit the control range.
